# SOI Threading Salon

SOI Threading Salon is a premium beauty salon located at 180 Hamburg Turnpk, Wayne, NJ 07470.

Website: https://soithreadingandsalon.com
Phone: 551-301-3894
Email: soithreadingsalon@gmail.com
Instagram: @SOITHREADINGSALON

## Business Summary

SOI Threading Salon provides expert eyebrow threading, full face threading, waxing, facials, hair care, henna, eyelash lifting, eyelash extensions, and men's grooming services in Wayne, New Jersey.

## Primary Services

- Eyebrow Threading
- Upper Lip Threading
- Chin Threading
- Full Face Threading
- Full Face with Neck Threading
- Waxing
- Facials
- Hair Care
- Henna
- Eyelash Lifting
- Eyelash Extensions
- Men's Grooming
